title: TEHRAN, October 26 - Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy for Foreign Policy and International Security of the Supreme National Security Council stated that senior officials from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey would visit Iran in a joint meeting.
text:
TEHRAN, October 26 - Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy for Foreign Policy and International Security of the Supreme National Security Council stated that senior officials from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey would visit Iran in a joint meeting."

""

"SOT1, Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy Secretary for the Supreme National Security Council of Iran (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:42): “High-ranking officials from three countries, Saudi Arabia, Turkiye, and Pakistan, intend to travel to Tehran to hold a joint meeting with the Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council of the Islamic Republic of Iran for two purposes. Their first objective is to congratulate Major General Rezaei on assuming this important responsibility, and their second is to consult and engage in dialogue with the Secretary regarding regional security.""

"SOT2, Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy Secretary for the Supreme National Security Council of Iran (Farsi)-(00:43 - 01:10): “Based on an agreement that has been made, Prince Khalid, Saudi Arabia's Minister of Defense, will participate; from Pakistan, General Asim Munir, the Chief of Army Staff, will participate; and from Turkey, Mr. Ibrahim Kalin, the head of the Turkish intelligence agency, will be present at this meeting.""

"SOT3, Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy Secretary for the Supreme National Security Council of Iran (Farsi)-(01:11 - 02:00): “It is clear that, given the successes of the Iranian nation and our armed forces in standing up to the aggressions of the US and Zionist regimes, and their failure to achieve their aggressive goals, the Islamic Republic of Iran's defense model based on internal and domestic capabilities has become a successful model for national security building. On the other hand, the strategic policy of the Islamic Republic of Iran has been and remains that regional security must be provided and guaranteed by the countries of the region.""

"SOT4, Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy Secretary for the Supreme National Security Council of Iran (Farsi)-(02:01 - 03:07): “Any interference and influence by foreigners, headed by the US regime, as well as the role played by the illegitimate Zionist regime at any level in the region, are disruptive to regional security and stability. Therefore, by utilizing the successful experience of the Islamic Republic of Iran in national security building, and within the framework of Iran's effective idea of regional security building through the participation of regional actors and what can be called "endogenous security," this four-country summit in Tehran can in theory be an effective and important step in shaping endogenous security in the region.""

"SOT5, Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy Secretary for the Supreme National Security Council of Iran (Farsi): “We hope that this initiative and movement, which is in fact the fruit of the heroic struggles and efforts of our armed forces and our nation, can serve as a precursor to building regional security, stability, and peace, and, God willing, be on the path toward progress.
